article.headline: No. 1 Florida hosts Merrimack after Lesburt's 25-point outing
article.title: No. 1 Florida hosts Merrimack after Lesburt's 25-point outing
article.linkText: No. 1 Florida hosts Merrimack after Lesburt's 25-point outing
article.story: Merrimack Warriors (1-2) at Florida Gators (3-0) Gainesville, Florida; Friday, 7 p.m. EST LINE: Gators -37.5; over/under is 143.5 BOTTOM LINE: Merrimack plays No. 1 Florida after AJ Lesburt Jr. scored 25 points in Merrimack's 73-60 win against the Albany (NY) Great Danes. Florida finished 27-8 overall with a 14-1 record at home during the 2025-26 season. The Gators allowed opponents to score 71.5 points per game and shoot 40.7% from the field last season. Merrimack went 23-11 overall with a 9-8 record on the road a season ago. The Warriors averaged 68.5 points per game while allowing opponents to score 66.5 last season. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
